$comment: The source of sf-alert-bar's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, aliases.json, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 and vocabulary 1.1.5: the page alert bar the Larena storage thread asked for (Federation bus msg-f8fd87ae998c44438cc7), from the owner-approved prototype «Плашка важных уведомлений» (claude.ai artifact BAtvwTPsumKqguQgDwngaM, 2026-11-05).

items.summary: The current conditions, each {id, level error|warning|info (danger, the former word, reads as error), text, source?, time?, action?: {label, href}, acknowledge?: {label}, dismissible?}. A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again when a condition appears or ends. The bar sorts them: error, warning, info, the newest first by time (ISO 8601), and takes its colour from the first. dismissible false keeps a warning or an info item from being closed; an error item is never closed, only minimized

size.summary: The ladder rung: the text line, the icon, the buttons and the bar's insets follow it. 1/2 is the bar above an admin header; 1 a bar on a site page with larger type

label.summary: The region's name; «Важные уведомления» / «Important notices» in the page language when not set

minimized.summary: The error bar is minimized to a thin strip that keeps the count and expands again on a press. Only a bar whose most serious item is an error is minimized; a page that kept the state sets it back. An error item that was not in the list before expands the bar again

navigate.summary: A person pressed an item's action link (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

acknowledge.summary: A person pressed an item's acknowledge button («Прочитано»): the host records that the condition was seen, for every person it concerns, until it happens again. Not cancelled, the item leaves the bar until the host sets the list again

close.summary: A person closed an item (reason close) or a page called close(id) (reason api): hide day for a warning (hidden for 24 hours), always for an info item (hidden for good). The bar stores nothing: the host keeps the choice and leaves the item out when it sets the list again. Not cancelled, the item leaves the bar at once. An error item is never closed

minimize.summary: The error bar was minimized to its strip (minimized true) or expanded again (false): by a press, or, expanding, by an error item that was not in the list before. The fact after the change; the page may keep it and set minimized back on the next page

close.summary: Closes the item with this id as its close button would, sending sf-alert-bar-close with reason api: refused {reason: missing} for an id the bar does not show, {reason: danger} for an error item or one with dismissible false, {reason: prevented} when a page cancels sf-alert-bar-close

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The bar is a region named by label. It is no live region itself, so a bar present when the page loads is not read out and paging does not speak. Two visually hidden live regions inside it announce what appears later: an error item that was not in the list before in the alert region (assertive), any other new item in the status region (polite). Nothing takes focus; every control is a native button or link, and Escape closes the open list and returns focus to its toggle.

x-summary: A full-width bar above a page or admin header for the conditions that need action now: error, warning, info. One bar for all of them, coloured by the most serious; it shows the most serious, and the others are listed under the bar with «All N». Warning closes for a day, info for good, error only minimizes to a strip. It stores nothing: the host keeps what was closed.

x-source.brief: Federation bus msg-f8fd87ae998c44438cc7 from the Larena storage thread; owner-approved prototype claude.ai artifact BAtvwTPsumKqguQgDwngaM «Плашка важных уведомлений» (2026-11-05) with the owner's decisions: levels danger, warning, info; colour of the most serious; danger→warning→info, newest first; paging and «All N» on wide screens, two lines under 600 px; warning hides 24 h, info for good, danger only minimizes; events, no storage

x-decisions: name: sf-alert-bar, a variant of block alert (ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md: sf-<block>-<variant>). sf-alert is one notice in the page flow with its own heading, two actions and a close; the bar is a list of conditions in one strip above the page, sorted, paged and minimized, so it is a component of its own in the same family, not a setting of sf-alert. It reuses sf-alert's status icons (info, warning, error) and the theme's status roles, and draws its controls with sf-button, sf-button-icon and sf-badge.

levels: danger, warning, info (owner, 2026-11-05). danger is drawn with the theme's error roles (--sf-error, --sf-on-error), as sf-alert draws its status error; the item data keeps the owner's word. Any other level is read as info.

colour: the bar is the most serious item's status colour, filled (--sf-error, --sf-warning, --sf-info with their on- roles, light and dark from the theme). Inside the bar the surface roles the controls read (on-surface, on-surface-variant, outline, the hover and active fills) are set to the fill's on- role, so sf-button and sf-button-icon of scheme on-surface draw on the coloured bar without a scheme of their own. The list under the bar is an ordinary surface with a tonal sf-badge per level.
order: danger, warning, info; inside a level the newest first by time (ISO 8601). An item without a readable time keeps its place in the host's order after the timed ones of its level.

events: navigate (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}) is the action link's cancelable request; the owner's «action» is this verb. close (§5 close, cancelable, as sf-alert's) carries hide day for a warning and always for an info item, so the host knows how long to keep it; dismiss is a synonym of close and is not a verb of its own. acknowledge is an own verb (§5.1): the condition was seen by the people it concerns until it happens again, which §5 read (one reader's message) does not mean. minimize (§5 minimize) is the fact after the danger bar was minimized or expanded, {minimized}. The bar stores nothing: a closed or acknowledged item leaves the bar at once, and the host leaves it out when it sets the list again.

danger: never closed. Its button minimizes the whole bar to a strip of the next rung down that keeps the level's colour, the icon and the count and expands on a press. A danger item that was not in the list before expands a minimized bar again.

paging: the first item is shown; with several, «‹ 1 of N ›» pages them (wrapping) and «All N» opens the list of all under the bar, each item with its own action, acknowledge and close. Under 600 px of the bar's own width (a container query) the icon, the text and the close share the first line, the actions go under the text, the arrows are not drawn and «All N» stands at the line's end.

a11y: the bar is a region named by label and not a live region, so a bar printed with the page is not read out (sf-alert's own guidance: no role alert on a notice present at load). Two visually hidden live regions announce what appears later: a new danger item in role alert, any other new item in role status. Nothing takes focus. When the focused control leaves (its item closed), focus goes to the next control of the bar, never to the page.
motion: the list opens with a short fade under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only; the colour change has no transition under reduce.

geometry: one rung (size 1/2 by default, or 1): the text the rung's line, the icon that line, the buttons the rung's low control height (C117, height low: L + 2 × the rung's low tightness step, 28 at 1/2 and 32 at 1 on desktop), the bar's block inset (H − L) / 2 so the text stands where a control's label stands, its inline inset the rung's space-x, icon-to-text the rung's text-space-x. The minimized strip is a control of the rung below (1/3 or 1/2).

css-variables: six public variables (§6) -- the three level fills, the bar's inline inset, the gap between its parts and the list's background -- listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json; the Framework never sets one.

version 1.0.1 (Larena, 2026-11-05: «Отметить, что видели» cut short at 1296 px): an action keeps its label's natural width -- the native control of each sf-button in the actions is flex: none and nowrap, never shrunk or cut. The message gives way first (flex 1 1 10rem, its floor min(10rem, 100%)), then the actions wrap onto a line of their own (the actions block wraps, end-aligned); before, a bar 600-700 px wide squeezed the text to nothing and ran the actions out of the bar. Probe: tests/browser/alert-bar-actions.browser.mjs at 1296, 1296 in a 640 px column and 390.

version 1.0.2 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-08; one number above the two unreleased 1.1.0 it joins): a minor (§4.10; docs review R031, owner decisions C13, C16). The bar reports conditions, so its most serious level is error, as on every message (alert, badge, toast, field); danger -- the word of the first brief -- reads as error and is noted once (change journal value-alert-bar-level-danger-to-error). The bar's class is sf-alert-bar--error; the danger class still draws. The level badge in the list takes the level word as its status. close(id) still answers {reason: danger} for an item that cannot be closed: an outcome has no alias to carry a rename. The bar's own controls write sf-button-icon's ghost, the name of the look without a fill (rule C15). The public variables end in -color (C16 naming): --sf-alert-bar-error-background-color, --sf-alert-bar-warning-background-color, --sf-alert-bar-info-background-color, --sf-alert-bar-list-background-color; the former names --sf-alert-bar-danger-background, --sf-alert-bar-warning-background, --sf-alert-bar-info-background, --sf-alert-bar-list-background are still read under the new ones until 2027-01-01 (change journal token-component-background-color-names, src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json).

version 1.2.2: the size rule C18 (2026-11-09): the text's floor is the size step f0 (10rem, as before); the list of all scrolls past g1, 352 px (it was 22.5rem, 360 px, no step: 8 px less); the narrow layout holds up to g9, 38rem, 608 px of the bar's own width (it was 600 px, no step: a bar 601-608 px wide now takes the narrow layout); the raw fallbacks of --sf-px and --sf-focus--width are gone (the tokens are always defined, nothing moves); the list's entry slides 4 px as before, written as the step a4. Also: a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, close({id}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, close(<string>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-09): each level is a strong coloured place (C16, the background system, owner 2026-11-08): what stands on the bar takes the level's ink on the alpha scale (states 4/8/12, fill 12/16/20, line 24, boundary 64, dim ink 80) from mix/_mix__places.scss instead of its own color-mix; the list of bars stands on an area place.

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-10): a patch; nothing in the component changed. Its built sheet is a place (sf-place) and, with C43 (component.badges 1.5.0, tokens.colour 1.8.0), takes back the core role --sf-surface-underlay with one line, --sf-surface-underlay: initial, so a tonal badge inside it lays its tone over its own surface and not over a row further out. Nothing is drawn differently outside a selected row. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-10): a patch, nothing drawn differently. Each level row declares its fill as the solid place colour too (--sf-surface-place-solid, C43), so a selected row on the bar stacks its badges over the bar's colour. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-10, pair next integration): one number for the two 1.3.2 notes above, the integration's underlay patch and C43's solid place on each level row, which were claimed separately; they ship together and 1.3.2 is never released alone. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.4 (2026-11-10, C16 leftovers; written as a note on 1.3.3, which is released): a patch; nothing draws differently. Its sheet reads the C16 role name --sf-surface-area where it read the former --sf-surface-1 (an alias of it until 2027-01-01, token-c16-theme-role-names), so a page that sets the new name reaches it; the value is the same in both themes and on every place. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. (the list's fill)

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-10, owner decision C40): an item's time is sf-time (cl-time), the Framework's one way to write a moment. Within a day it is relative as before (threshold P1D); older it reads as sf-time's auto («вчера, 19:40», «5 ноября», with the year when it is not this one) where 1.3 printed the medium date and the time; the full moment is in sf-time's tooltip, reached by the pointer and by Tab, and Escape hides it. Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.4.0, also (2026-11-11, written on the pair's 1.3.4, carried by 1.4.0): each level declares --sf-surface-place-ground, the nearest opaque place, with its fill, as every solid place does. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-12, owner decision C112, R198; one number above the released 1.4.1): the close cross is the strong place's on-surface ink at 64 of the alpha scale's ink family (white at 64 in the light theme, the level's tone 20 at 64 in the dark), as the cross of sf-alert and sf-toast, instead of the solid on-colour of the text; under a pointer it catches the text ink. Its size is unchanged: the bar's line, the size of its status icon. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-13, owner decisions C114 and C115, C105; AA-14..AA-17, NS-8, NS-11; one number above the unreleased 1.4.2 it joins): a minor. The job is the state of the whole product that needs action now (C114 (1)); the sentence stands in the docs beside sf-alert (a page or section), sf-toast (a short reply to an action), the notification centre (history) and sf-confirm (a decision). No paging arrows (C114 (3)): the bar shows the most serious item and «All N» opens the list; the pager, its position text and the prev/next words are gone. One button family (AA-15, C110): the action tonal surface, acknowledge, «All N», close and minimize ghost («All N» was tonal). Horizontal steps of C105 (AA-14): edge --sf-space-1 (16, phone 12), icon to text --sf-space-1/2 (12, phone 8), text to actions --sf-space-1 (16), between buttons and actions to the end button --sf-space-1/3 (8, phone 4); they were the rung's space-x and text-space-x (14 / 7 / 14 / 7). The fill stays full-bleed and strong (C114 (4)); the content stands on the page column (C114 (2), AA-16): a size 1 (site) bar takes the .container inset of the window's step (gutter + half of what the bar is wider than the step), so its icon lines up with sf-header-site's logo; a size 1/2 (admin) bar keeps the edge; --sf-alert-bar-padding-inline still overrides both. Narrow (up to 38rem): the actions start at the text start (AA-17, C114 (5)), 12 under the text (phone 8, C115), and the bottom inset is even with the top (NS-8): the block inset + (H − L) / 2 + (L − 1cap) / 2 under the last button. The acknowledge word is «Прочитано» / «Mark as read» (C114 (2), NS-11). Button height (owner decision C117, NS-13): every button of the bar and of its list (action, acknowledge, «All N», close, minimize, the list's close) is height="low" (C27), the notice family's one button height (sf-alert, sf-toast, C35), and the rung's control H the bar is built on is that low step, L + 2 × --sf-ui-<rung>--space-y-tightness-low, not the rung's default control height: 28 at 1/2 and 32 at 1 on desktop (were 32 and 40). The bar loses 4 (1/2) or 8 (1) on one line -- 36 admin, 40 site -- and the even bottom of the narrow bar (NS-8) is computed from the same step. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged; the open «Ещё N» list of C114 (3) (NS-12) is not in this version.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: keeping what was closed or acknowledged (the host stores it and leaves the item out)
deciding who sees a condition (the host lists only what the person may see)
deciding when a condition ends (the host sets the list again)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-alert-bar once per page, above the page or admin header, for the current conditions that need action now: a disk nearly full, a failed backup, a site that does not answer, an update.
do_not: Do not use sf-alert-bar for news that needs no action (a backup done); send it to a notification centre or a toast
Do not put two bars on one page; give one bar every condition
Do not keep closed items in the component; store the choice in the host and leave the item out
Do not use sf-alert-bar for a notice inside the page flow; sf-alert does that
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-alert-bar><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "backup", "level": "warning", "text": "Последняя копия сайта не удалась.", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "/backups/"}, "dismissible": true}]}</script></sf-alert-bar>

keyboard: Tab reaches the action link, acknowledge, each item's time (its tooltip), the paging arrows, «All N» and close in order
Enter or Space presses a control; Enter follows the action link
Escape closes the open list and returns focus to «All N»
accessibility.focus: The bar never takes focus. A control that leaves (its item closed or acknowledged) hands focus to the next control of the bar, so focus never falls to the page.
